faqs.question: When does Duval County school start in 2026?
faqs.answer: The first day of school for Duval County Public Schools is Monday, August 10, 2026. Employee planning and in-service days take place August 3-7, before students begin classes.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school in Duval County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027, is the scheduled last day of school and the end of the final grading period. If weather closures require additional instructional days, the district may use June 1 or 2 and extend the school year.

faqs.question: Was the Duval County 2026-2027 school calendar revised?
faqs.answer: Yes. The School Board approved a revised calendar on April 7, 2026. The changes include no classes during Thanksgiving week, student-free days on October 12-13 and March 11-12, and regular classes on November 12-13. Families should use the revised calendar rather than an earlier copy.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Duval County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes November 23-27, 2026. Schools are closed November 23-25, and both schools and administrative offices are closed November 26-27. Including the surrounding weekends, students are off November 21-29 and return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter or Christmas break for Duval schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: December 18 is the last scheduled class day before winter break. Schools are closed December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students also have no classes January 4-5 because of staff days, so they return Wednesday, January 6.

faqs.question: When is Duval County spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: The official spring break school closure is March 15-19, 2027. Students also have no classes Thursday, March 11, and Friday, March 12, because of staff days. Their continuous break from classes runs March 11-21, with school resuming Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is there school on October 12 and 13, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12, is an employee planning and in-service day, and Tuesday, October 13, is a professional development day. Students return Wednesday, October 14. Both dates are student-free under the revised calendar.

faqs.question: Do Duval students have school on November 11, 12 and 13, 2026?
faqs.answer: Schools and administrative offices are closed Wednesday, November 11, for Veterans Day. Students are scheduled to attend classes Thursday, November 12, and Friday, November 13. Those two days are regular school days under the revised calendar.

faqs.question: Are Duval schools closed on March 11 and 12, 2027?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on either day. March 11 is a professional development day, and March 12 is an employee planning and in-service day. Both are immediately before the March 15-19 spring break closure.

faqs.question: What other school holidays are on the 2026-2027 Duval calendar?
faqs.answer: Outside the longer breaks, schools and administrative offices are closed September 7 and November 11, 2026, and January 18, February 15 and March 26, 2027. These dates coincide with Labor Day, Veterans Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Presidents Day and Good Friday. Memorial Day, May 31, falls after the scheduled last student day.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday, March 26, 2027, part of spring break?
faqs.answer: No. Spring break is March 15-19, and classes resume March 22. Schools and administrative offices close again on Friday, March 26. Monday, March 29, is a weather make-up date, so families should not assume students will have a guaranteed four-day weekend.

faqs.question: What are Duval County's weather make-up days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The dates are March 29, April 26, June 1 and June 2, 2027. The district says it will use them in chronological order if school days are lost to weather. Students do not attend on unused weather dates, but any date activated as a make-up day becomes an instructional day. June 1-2 could extend the school year.

faqs.question: Are there early-release days in Duval County schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: No regular early-release days are scheduled for 2026-2027. The district's back-to-school guide confirms that staff professional development will take place on designated in-service days instead. Check school messages for any campus-specific dismissal changes.

faqs.question: What time do Duval County schools start and dismiss students?
faqs.answer: For 2026-2027, standard elementary school hours are 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., middle school hours are 9:30 a.m. to 4:15 p.m., and high school hours are 7:10 a.m. to 2:05 p.m. Several schools follow exception schedules, so check your school's listed hours before arranging transportation or pickup.

faqs.question: Does Jean Ribault High School follow the standard high school bell schedule?
faqs.answer: Do not assume Jean Ribault High follows the standard 7:10 a.m. to 2:05 p.m. schedule. The district's 2026-2027 exception listing and the school's own information give conflicting hours. Confirm the current start and dismissal times directly with Jean Ribault High.

faqs.question: When do Duval County grading periods end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The published grading-period end dates are October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 10 and May 28, 2027. A grading-period end date does not automatically mean students have the day off or leave school early.

faqs.question: Where can Duval parents check report cards and progress reports?
faqs.answer: Parents can use Focus through their Duval Linked Parent Account to check grades and available reports. The academic calendar lists grading-period end dates but does not provide every report-card or progress-report release date. Check Focus and school announcements for reporting updates.

faqs.question: How many school days are in Duval County's 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The published dates work out to 177 planned student attendance weekdays between August 10 and May 28, assuming the two weather reserves within that period are not used. This is an independent calculation, not an annual total printed by the district. Weather-related changes could affect the actual attendance schedule.

faqs.question: Can I get a PDF of the Duval County 2026-2027 school calendar?
faqs.answer: The district publishes its calendar online at https://www.duvalschools.org/page/calendar2627. Although it no longer routinely distributes calendar PDFs publicly, its 2026-2027 back-to-school guide says families can request a color-coded PDF by emailing dcpsnews@duvalschools.org. The approved revision can also be viewed through the April 2026 School Board agenda.

faqs.question: When are Duval County graduation ceremonies and seniors' last day in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district's annual academic calendar does not list a separate last day for seniors or a 2027 graduation ceremony schedule. High school families should check their school's senior announcements and the district's graduation information rather than relying on the general May 28 last day.

editorialSummary.heading: What changed in Duval's 2026-2027 school calendar?
paragraphs: Duval County Public Schools revised its 2026-2027 calendar after feedback from parents and employees. Students now have the entire November 23-27 week off for Thanksgiving, along with student-free days on October 12 and 13. November 12 and 13 remain regular school days following the Veterans Day closure. The school year began Monday, August 10, 2026, and is scheduled to end Friday, May 28, 2027. Families using a calendar saved before the April revision should check these dates against the updated version.

The last class day before winter break is December 18. Schools are closed December 21 through January 1, followed by employee planning on January 4 and professional development on January 5. Students return Wednesday, January 6. In March, students have no classes on March 11 and 12 for staff days, immediately before the March 15-19 spring break closure. They return Monday, March 22. Schools close again on Friday, March 26, a separate holiday.

Duval has four weather make-up dates: March 29, April 26, June 1 and June 2, 2027. The district will use them in that order if weather closures require replacement school days. Unused dates remain student-free, but the June dates could extend the school year beyond May 28. The district has also confirmed that there are no regular early-release days in 2026-2027. School start and dismissal times still vary at some campuses.
highlights: November 23-27: no student classes during Thanksgiving week.
October 12-13: student-free planning and professional development days.
March 11-12: student-free staff days before the March 15-19 spring break closure.
June 1-2: possible weather make-up days after the scheduled last day.

faqs.question: When are Duval County graduation ceremonies and seniors' last day in 2028?

faqs.question: Is there a PDF of the Duval County 2027-2028 school calendar?
faqs.answer: The official 2027-2028 calendar is published as an HTML webpage at https://www.duvalschools.org/page/calendar2728. A public PDF for this specific school year has not been verified here. Use the district's published calendar rather than a PDF from an earlier school year.

faqs.question: Has Duval County Public Schools published an official 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district publishes its 2027-2028 academic calendar at https://www.duvalschools.org/page/calendar2728. This page is an independent summary based on those dates, not the district's official website. The published calendar does not specify a School Board approval date, and weather-day attendance may still change.

faqs.question: Where can I check for changes to the Duval County 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: Check the district's official calendar at https://www.duvalschools.org/page/calendar2728, along with Team Duval News and messages from your child's school. This is especially important for weather-related attendance changes, school hours and any adjustment to the final school day.

hero.heading: Duval County Public Schools Calendar 2027-2028
hero.mobileDescription: School starts August 10, 2027, and is scheduled to end May 26, 2028. Weather dates on May 30-31 could affect the finish.
hero.desktopDescription: Students have Thanksgiving week off November 22-26. After winter and spring staff days, classes resume January 5 and March 22. February 18 and April 17 are weather dates, not confirmed holidays.

editorialSummary.heading: School breaks, Wednesday returns and weather days
paragraphs: Duval County Public Schools lists Tuesday, August 10, 2027, as the first student day and Friday, May 26, 2028, as the scheduled last day. Students are off November 22-26 for Thanksgiving and return Monday, November 29. The published district calendar also includes school closures for Labor Day, Veterans Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Presidents Day and Good Friday.

Both winter and spring breaks are followed by student-free staff days. Schools close December 20-31, 2027, for winter break, with employee planning on January 3 and professional development on January 4. Students return Wednesday, January 5. Spring break closes schools March 13-17, 2028, followed by planning on March 20 and professional development on March 21. Classes resume Wednesday, March 22.

The district lists four Weather Days: February 18, April 17, May 30 and May 31, 2028. February 18 falls just before the confirmed February 21 school closure, while April 17 follows the April 14 closure. The annual calendar does not confirm student attendance for those two weather dates, so neither four-day weekend is guaranteed. May 30-31 fall after the scheduled May 26 last day and could extend the school year if used for instruction. Families should confirm 2027-2028 school hours separately, especially at campuses with different bell schedules.
highlights: First day of school: Tuesday, August 10, 2027.
Students return January 5 after winter break and March 22 after spring break.
February 18, April 17 and May 30-31 are weather-dependent dates.

2027-2028.noSchoolWeekdayStatisticExplanation: Counts 30 no-class weekdays from the published school closures and student-free staff dates between August 10 and May 26. February 18 and April 17 are Weather Days with attendance still to be confirmed and are excluded. The late-May weather dates are outside the scheduled student-year endpoints.
